description: This file defines the EqualBinary class in the Twig template engine, implementing the logic for the equality operator within expression nodes.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\Binary\EqualBinary
classes.description: Represents the binary 'equal' operator expression node in Twig's AST, providing compilation logic for rendering the equality check.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to perform an equality check between two expressions, with a special case for PHP 8 and above.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string '==' to denote the equality operator in the compiled PHP code.
